# ANALYSIS: OOS Test of Sniper Level Break in 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1

**Filed:** 2026-07-12
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We want to test the sniper level break setup (as defined in the playbook as a setup idea) in the out-of-sample periods 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1 to see if it has any edge without the profit_lock_threshold=0.0 artifact that invalidated previous attempts. The sniper level break is not targeting the OP-16 anchor days (which are BEARISH_REJECTION days), so we expect zero edge capture on those days. We are testing it as a standalone setup for potential OOS edge.

## Mechanism

We will run a backtest of the sniper level break trigger (level break with VIX>=18 and VIX-trend regime filter) but with realistic exit parameters (profit_lock_threshold > 0.0, e.g., 0.05 or 0.10) and using the chart-stop exit as in the SNIPER_CS_CHART_STOP candidate. We will test two variants: with and without the VIX-trend filter. The backtest will use realistic OPRA fills and be restricted to the 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1 periods. We will report the P&L, win rate, and concentration for these periods.

1. **Account-size assumption:** We assume the standard account size for 0DTE trading as per the playbook: $25K+ for full qty (15 contracts). For paper trading, we scale down accordingly.
2. **Sample bias:** We are testing only two quarters (2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1). This is a small sample and may not be representative. Overfit risk is high if we tune to these periods.

6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
